parents.title: For our parents
items: Daily updates are shared through the electronic notebook on the school platform.
You can contact teachers online through the 4schools school platform.
At the start of the school year, every teacher sets one day a week for phone appointments.
Scheduled meetings with teachers take place online or in person during the school year.
In an emergency, you can contact the school office online or by phone (Early Years only).
